name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
description: UNESCO World Heritage church (1605) holding the remains of St Francis Xavier. The ornate gilded altar and baroque interiors contrast with the plain classical layout. Open 9am–5pm weekdays, 11am–5pm Sundays.
hi_description: सेंट फ्रांसिस जेवियर के अवशेषों को संजोए यह यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर चर्च (1605) । भव्य सोने का पिछला पर्दा और बारोक इंटीरियर शास्त्रीय डिज़ाइन के साथ मिलते हैं ।

name: Sé Cathedral
description: Asia's largest church, built over 90 years (1562–1652). Features a giant bell and ornate golden altar. The vaulted interiors showcase Portuguese baroque architecture and intricate tile work.
hi_description: एशिया का सबसे बड़ा चर्च, 90 साल में बना (1562–1652) । विशाल घंटी और सोने की वेदी के साथ । पुर्तगाली बारोक वास्तुकला को दर्शाता है ।

name: Church of St Francis of Assisi
description: 16th-century church with an attached museum displaying Portuguese colonial artifacts, religious sculptures, and historical documents. Intricate wooden carvings and tile panels.
hi_description: 16वीं सदी का चर्च, संलग्न संग्रहालय पुर्तगाली औपनिवेशिक कलाकृतियों को दर्शाता है । जटिल लकड़ी की नक्काशी और टाइल पैनल ।

name: Palolem Beach
description: Crescent-shaped beach with calm, shallow water tucked between two headlands. Beach huts line the sand (seasonal, June–October dismantled for monsoon). Kayak rentals ₹200–₹300/hour.
hi_description: दो पहाड़ियों के बीच स्थित अर्धचंद्राकार समुद्र तट, शांत उथले पानी के साथ । काया किराए ₹200–₹300 प्रति घंटे ।

name: Butterfly Beach
description: Secluded cove inaccessible by road, reachable only by boat or trekking. Named for the butterflies that gather on the sand. Popular with kayakers and day-trippers seeking tranquility.
hi_description: सड़क से पहुंचने के लिए अगम्य एकांत कोव, केवल नाव द्वारा या ट्रेकिंग से पहुंचा जा सकता है ।

name: Patnem Beach
description: Quieter crescent beach 1km south of Palolem, a 30-minute walk away. Fewer crowds, cozy shacks, and bamboo huts. Clean sand and calm water suitable for families.
hi_description: पलोलेम के दक्षिण 1 किमी दूर शांत अर्धचंद्राकार समुद्र तट, कम भीड़ और आरामदायक झोपड़ियों के साथ ।

name: Fontainhas (Latin Quarter)
description: Heritage neighborhood with narrow lanes lined by color-washed Portuguese houses with azulejo tiles and wrought-iron balconies. Centuries-old Catholic families still reside here. Best explored on foot.
hi_description: संकीर्ण गलियों वाला धरोहर इलाका, रंगीन पुर्तगाली घरों, टाइलों और लोहे की बालकनियों से सजा हुआ ।

name: Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception
description: Iconic baroque church (originally 1541, rebuilt 1600s) perched on a hill above Panaji's main square. White facade with symmetrical staircase and bell tower. Feast celebrations on December 8.
hi_description: पनाजी के मुख्य चौराहे के ऊपर पहाड़ी पर स्थित प्रतिष्ठित बारोक चर्च । सफेद मुखौटा और सममित सीढ़ियों के साथ ।

name: Miramar Beach
description: City beach on the Mandovi River with evening strolls and sunset views. Less dramatic than coastal Goa beaches but good for walks and people-watching. Promenade shops and food stalls.
hi_description: मंडोवी नदी पर शहर समुद्र तट, शाम की सैर और सूर्यास्त के दृश्यों के साथ ।

name: Mandovi River Sunset Cruise
description: Evening boat cruises depart from the waterfront, offering views of Panaji's skyline, the Kala Academy, and the river estuary. Some boats serve refreshments. Booking required during peak season.
hi_description: जलमार्ग से शाम को नाव की सवारी, पनाजी के क्षितिज और नदी के दृश्य ।

name: Sahakari Spice Farm
description: Working spice plantation with nutmeg, pepper, cardamom, cinnamon, vanilla, and cashew trees. Guided walk, traditional Goan vegetarian lunch on banana leaves, and local feni (liquor) tasting included.
hi_description: जड़ी-बूटियों के साथ कार्यशील बागान — मसाले, परंपरागत गोवा थाली दोपहर के भोजन और स्थानीय फेनी टेस्टिंग के साथ ।

name: Shri Mangeshi Temple
description: Sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, built in Indo-Portuguese architectural style. Features a large tank, ornate domed gateway, and deepstambha (lamp tower). Active pilgrimage site.
hi_description: भगवान शिव को समर्पित पवित्र हिंदू मंदिर, इंडो-पुर्तगाली वास्तुकला शैली में निर्मित ।

name: Shri Shantadurga Temple
description: 18th-century temple dedicated to Goddess Durga, located in Kavalam village. Known for its peaceful atmosphere and ornate carvings. One of Goa's most important Hindu pilgrimage sites.
hi_description: देवी दुर्गा को समर्पित 18वीं सदी का मंदिर, शांतिपूर्ण माहौल और जटिल नक्काशी के लिए जाना जाता है ।

name: Reis Magos Fort
description: Historic fort (1551) overlooking the Mandovi River, Portugal's oldest in Goa. Beautifully restored with exhibitions, ramparts for river views, chapel with Portuguese tiles, and dungeons open to visitors.
hi_description: मंडोवी नदी के ऊपर ऐतिहासिक किला (1551), गोवा में पुर्तगाल का सबसे पुराना । पुनर्निर्मित, प्रदर्शनी और नदी के दृश्यों के साथ ।

name: Church of the Three Kings (Reis Magos Church)
description: Adjacent to the fort, built in 1555 by Franciscan friars. Named for the Three Wise Men, with a whitewashed gabled facade visible from across the river. Feast celebrations on January 6.
hi_description: किले के पास, 1555 में फ्रांसिस्कन भिक्षुओं द्वारा निर्मित, तीन ज्ञानी लोगों को समर्पित ।

name: St. Anthony's Church
description: Twin-steeple church (1630) in the heart of Siolim village. Unique altar statue of St. Anthony holding a serpent tied with cord, commemorating a shipwreck legend. White facade overlooking paddy fields.
hi_description: सिओलिम गाँव के केंद्र में जुड़वां घंटीदार चर्च (1630) । संत अंतोनी की अद्वितीय मूर्ति रस्सी से बंधे सांप को पकड़े हुए ।

name: Chapora River Sunset Boat Cruise
description: Evening boat cruises depart from Siolim Jetty along the Chapora estuary. Views of river backwaters, fishing boats, and surrounding villages. Operational November–May. Dolphin spotting possible.
hi_description: सिओलिम जेटी से शाम की नाव की सवारी, चापोरा एस्टुअरी के साथ नदी के दृश्य ।

name: Siolim-Chopdem Bridge
description: 499-meter bridge (opened 2002) connecting Siolim to Pernem taluka. Gateway to northern beaches (Morjim, Ashwem, Arambol). Stunning estuary views at sunset. Walking and cycling paths available.
hi_description: 499 मीटर का पुल (2002) सिओलिम को उत्तरी तटों से जोड़ता है, सूर्यास्त के दृश्यों के साथ ।

name: Chapora Fort
description: Historic fort (17th century, renovated by Portuguese) perched above Vagator Beach. Open ramparts with views across the Arabian Sea and adjacent beaches. Famous Dil Chahta Hai movie bench site.
hi_description: वागाटोर समुद्र तट के ऊपर ऐतिहासिक किला, अरब सागर के दृश्य और फिल्म दिल चाहता है स्थान के साथ ।

name: Little Vagator (Ozran Beach)
description: Smaller, quieter beach enclosed by red laterite cliffs. Famous for the carved Shiva face on the cliff rock. Rock pools at low tide, secluded coves, and fewer crowds than Big Vagator.
hi_description: लाल लेटराइट चट्टानों से घिरा छोटा शांत समुद्र तट, चट्टान पर शिव मुख की नक्काशी के साथ ।

name: Big Vagator Beach
description: Wider crescent beach separated from Little Vagator by a headland with a car park. Dramatic red cliffs, calm water, and sunset views. Main beach hub with beach bars and water sports.
hi_description: लाल चट्टानों वाला विस्तृत अर्धचंद्राकार समुद्र तट, सूर्यास्त के दृश्य और जल क्रीड़ा के साथ ।
